title: New Insights Into the Mueller Report

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Mueller team sent its report to the Attorney General, William Barr.
sentences.zh: 今天，穆勒团队将他们的报告送交给了司法部长威廉·巴尔。

sentences.en: The Attorney General sent a summary of that report to Congress.
sentences.zh: 司法部长将该报告的摘要发送给了国会。

sentences.en: Now, new reporting shows members of Mueller's team feel that Barr's summary did not reflect the report they wrote.
sentences.zh: 现在，新的报道显示，穆勒团队的成员认为巴尔的摘要并未反映他们所撰写的报告。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 4月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: So take us back to the beginning of last week.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们回到上周初。

sentences.en: What do we know at that point?
sentences.zh: 当时我们都知道些什么？

sentences.en: So we knew that Bill Barr, taking Bob Mueller's three to four hundred page report, had gone through it extensively and boiled down what he called the
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道，小威廉·巴尔拿到了罗伯特·穆勒长达三四百页的报告，对其进行了详尽的审阅，并将他所谓的

sentences.en: principal conclusions to just four pages.
sentences.zh: 主要结论精简到了仅仅四页。

sentences.en: Nick Fandos covers Congress.
sentences.zh: 尼克·范多斯负责国会报道。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt covers national security.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特负责国家安全报道。

sentences.en: We were in this unusual situation where the special counsel, Robert Mueller, had sent his
sentences.zh: 我们当时处于这样一种不同寻常的境地：特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒将他的

sentences.en: report to the Attorney General, said, I found no evidence that the campaign conspired with Russia to impact the election.
sentences.zh: 报告提交给了司法部长，并表示：“我没有发现竞选团队与俄罗斯串通以影响选举的证据。”

sentences.en: But he declined to make a decision on obstruction.
sentences.zh: 但他拒绝就妨碍司法公正做出决定。

sentences.en: And what he said was
sentences.zh: 而他说的是

sentences.en: Mueller didn't reach what Barr called a traditional prosecutorial decision.
sentences.zh: 穆勒没有得出巴尔所说的传统起诉决定。

sentences.en: In other words, Mueller presented evidence for the fact that the president may have obstructed justice, but didn't go as far as to conclude that he had.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，穆勒出示了总统可能妨碍司法公正的证据，但没有走得那么远去断定他确实这样做了。

sentences.en: He essentially punted to the Attorney General's office.
sentences.zh: 他基本上把球踢给了司法部长办公室。

sentences.en: And in this case, by
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，通过

sentences.en: Mueller not reaching a determination, he leaves the door open for Barr to come in to say, OK, Mueller didn't make a determination on this issue of obstruction.
sentences.zh: 穆勒不作裁决，他为巴尔介入敞开了大门，让巴尔可以说：“好吧，穆勒在这个妨碍司法公正的问题上没有做出裁决。”

sentences.en: He did on collusion.
sentences.zh: 他在串通问题上做出了裁决。

sentences.en: I'm going to look at all the facts.
sentences.zh: 我来查看所有事实。

sentences.en: And he makes a determination.
sentences.zh: 然后他做出裁决。

sentences.en: No case to be made here on both of these issues.
sentences.zh: 这两个问题在这里都不成立。

sentences.en: The problem, though, is that the perception is that Mueller, the independent investigator who's there to do
sentences.zh: 然而问题在于，人们的看法是，穆勒这位旨在进行

sentences.en: an inquiry free of politics, has not made a call on this central question.
sentences.zh: 不受政治影响的调查的独立调查员，没有对这个核心问题做出最终判定。

sentences.en: But Barr, the president's appointee, who's been there just for a few months, is making the decision.
sentences.zh: 但上任仅几个月的总统任命官员巴尔却在做决定。

sentences.en: So the question is, is the fix in?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，这是内定好的吗？

sentences.en: Why is it if Mueller didn't come to an answer, the attorney general did?
sentences.zh: 为什么如果穆勒没有得出答案，司法部长却得出了答案？

sentences.en: So at the beginning of last week, we know that Mueller made the unusual decision not to make a call.
sentences.zh: 所以在上周初，我们知道穆勒做出了不予置评的不寻常决定。

sentences.en: And Barr made the unusual decision to make a call.
sentences.zh: 而巴尔做出了发表意见的不寻常决定。

sentences.en: And the question is, why?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为什么？

sentences.en: It's not unusual that Barr made a call.
sentences.zh: 巴尔发表意见并不寻常。

sentences.en: The Justice Department is there to decide whether people broke the law or not.
sentences.zh: 司法部的职责就是决定人们是否违法。

sentences.en: And he was doing that.
sentences.zh: 他当时就是在做这件事。

sentences.en: But what's different and unusual here is that Barr and Mueller don't look like they're on the same page.
sentences.zh: 但这里不同且不寻常的是，巴尔和穆勒看起来并不步调一致。

sentences.en: Mueller said, I can't make a determination on this issue.
sentences.zh: 穆勒说：“我无法对这个问题做出裁决。”

sentences.en: And Barr did.
sentences.zh: 而巴尔却做了。

sentences.en: So why is it that they looked at it differently?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么他们对此有不同的看法呢？

sentences.en: Why was it that Mueller, the prosecutor here, didn't do the one thing that prosecutors at the Justice Department do, which is make a call?
sentences.zh: 为什么身为检察官的穆勒没有做司法部检察官们唯一会做的事——做出裁决呢？

sentences.en: And that was the question that we've spent the last week trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们过去一周一直在试图弄清楚的问题。

sentences.en: What is the difference here?
sentences.zh: 这里的区别在哪里？

sentences.en: What is the evidence that they're looking at?
sentences.zh: 他们正在查看的证据是什么？

sentences.en: And why did Mueller and Barr make the decisions that they made around this question of obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 为什么穆勒和巴尔围绕妨碍司法公正这个问题做出了各自的决定？

sentences.en: And what have we now learned?
sentences.zh: 我们现在了解到了什么？

sentences.en: What we've now learned is that nobody's happy.
sentences.zh: 我们现在了解到的是，没有人高兴。

sentences.en: The team that was working or at least some of the team that was working with Bob Mueller feels
sentences.zh: 一直在与罗伯特·穆勒合作的团队，或者至少是部分团队感觉

sentences.en: that Barr stepped in and filled a vacuum in a way that didn't properly capture what their 22-month investigation found.
sentences.zh: 巴尔介入并填补了一个真空，其方式未能准确捕捉到他们为期 22 个月的调查所发现的内容。

sentences.en: And Barr's team feels that Bob Mueller fell short of doing his job.
sentences.zh: 而巴尔的团队则觉得罗伯特·穆勒未能尽职。

sentences.en: So let's start with the Barr side.
sentences.zh: 那我们先从巴尔这一方说起。

sentences.en: Explain more about why the attorney general and those around him are upset.
sentences.zh: 请详细解释一下为什么司法部长及其身边的人会感到不满。

sentences.en: So in not reaching a decision on obstruction of justice, Barr has to go out on
sentences.zh: 所以在没有对妨碍司法公正做出决定的情况下，巴尔不得不孤注一掷

sentences.en: his own and make that determination without the top cover of the independent investigator who went out
sentences.zh: 自己去做出那个裁决，而没有那位本应去确定总统是否触犯法律的

sentences.en: and was supposed to make a determination on whether the president broke the law.
sentences.zh: 独立调查员的最高掩护。

sentences.en: And what do you mean by top cover?
sentences.zh: 你所说的“最高掩护”是什么意思？

sentences.en: One of the reasons you have a special counsel is to insulate an investigation from politics.
sentences.zh: 拥有特别检察官的原因之一就是将调查与政治隔离开来。

sentences.en: And then when the investigation is concluded, have a way of holding up the product of the inquiry, the fruits of it to the public and saying, look, this was done free of politics.
sentences.zh: 然后在调查结束后，有一种方式可以向公众展示调查的成果，即把调查的果实呈献给公众并说：“看，这是在没有政治干预的情况下完成的。”

sentences.en: We assess this matter based on the facts.
sentences.zh: 我们根据事实评估了此事。

sentences.en: And now you have a result that is exposed, at least in part, to the perception that the president's guy made the decision.
sentences.zh: 而现在你得到了一个结果，它至少在某种程度上暴露出一种印象，即总统的人做出了决定。

sentences.en: The attorney general.
sentences.zh: 司法部长。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Undercutting one of the key points of Mueller's appointment in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这削弱了最初任命穆勒的关键点之一。

sentences.en: And you're saying that the people in the Justice Department and that Barr himself are upset to be put in that position.
sentences.zh: 你是说司法部的人以及巴尔本人对被置于这种境地感到不满。

sentences.en: Well, the system's not working the way it's supposed to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个系统没有按预期的那样运转。

sentences.en: You had Mueller there for one reason.
sentences.zh: 你让穆勒去只有一个原因。

sentences.en: Yay or nay on crimes.
sentences.zh: 对犯罪行为说“是”或“否”。

sentences.en: And on one of these central questions, he couldn't get there.
sentences.zh: 但在其中一个核心问题上，他未能得出结论。

sentences.en: And by stepping back and saying, I don't know, it allows at least the Democrats to say, what?
sentences.zh: 而通过退一步说“我不知道”，这至少让民主党人得以发问：什么？

sentences.en: How was this decision made?
sentences.zh: 这个决定是怎么做出的？

sentences.en: How did they get to this?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么得出这个结论的？

sentences.en: How is it that the president's political appointee was the ultimate decider?
sentences.zh: 为什么总统的政治任命官员成了最终的决定者？

sentences.en: And it gives them real credence to go and say, we need to see all the evidence.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们充分的理由去说：“我们需要看到所有的证据。”

sentences.en: We need to see the whole file here because the president's handpicked man made this decision.
sentences.zh: “我们需要看到这里的全部档案，因为总统亲自挑选的人做出了这个决定。”

sentences.en: Maybe we'd reach a different conclusion if we looked at the evidence.
sentences.zh: “如果我们查看了证据，也许我们会得出不同的结论。”

sentences.en: Bob Mueller seems to have.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·穆勒似乎已经这么做了。

sentences.en: So then why did Barr choose to make a call on obstruction of justice if he knew and was upset
sentences.zh: 那么，既然巴尔知道并对以下情况感到不满：

sentences.en: that this was going to be seen as hyperpolitical and that it would fan the flames of Democrats in
sentences.zh: 这会被视为极具政治色彩，并会火上浇油激怒国会中的

sentences.en: Congress?
sentences.zh: 民主党人，为什么他还要选择对妨碍司法公正做出裁决呢？

sentences.en: The problem for Barr was that when he got the report and looked at the evidence, to him,
sentences.zh: 对巴尔来说，问题在于当他拿到报告并查看证据时，在他看来，

sentences.en: it was a pretty clear case that you would not press this kind of charge, that the president hadn't obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当明确的案例，即你不应该提出这种指控，总统没有妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: Now, you've got to remember that Barr comes to the job with a pretty expansive view of executive power.
sentences.zh: 现在，你必须记住，巴尔上任时对行政权力有着相当广泛的看法。

sentences.en: As Democrats made famous, he wrote a memo before he was appointed attorney general arguing that certain acts by the president shouldn't be construed as obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 正如民主党人所广为熟知的，他在被任命为司法部长之前曾写过一份备忘录，辩称总统的某些行为不应被解释为妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: They're part of his executive powers.
sentences.zh: 它们是他行政权力的一部分。

sentences.en: And so he looks at this and I mean, he can't make the same decision that Mueller did.
sentences.zh: 所以他看了看这个，我的意思是，他不可能做出与穆勒相同的决定。

sentences.en: Somebody has to make a choice about whether or not this is a chargeable offense.
sentences.zh: 总得有人对这是否是一项可起诉的罪行做出选择。

sentences.en: And he looks at it and says, well, in our judgment and this team's judgment, it's not.
sentences.zh: 而他看了看并说，好吧，在我们和这个团队的判断中，这不是。

sentences.en: So Barr reads the report and thinks, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 所以巴尔读了报告后心想：你们在说什么？

sentences.en: It's not clear whether or not there was obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 是否存在妨碍司法公正并不含糊。

sentences.en: There, in his mind, clearly wasn't.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，显然没有。

sentences.en: Barr does acknowledge that there is evidence, basically, of behavior that could be construed as obstructive.
sentences.zh: 巴尔确实承认存在证据，基本上是那些可以被解释为具有妨碍性质的行为的证据。

sentences.en: He gives credence to what Mueller is presenting, but says when you add it all up, it doesn't tip into criminal, obstructive territory.
sentences.zh: 他认可穆勒所呈现的内容，但表示当你把所有这些加在一起时，它还没有达到构成犯罪和妨碍司法的地步。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And while it felt political for Barr to reach a conclusion, to make a call that Mueller wouldn't, I have to think it would have felt even more political in Barr's mind for Congress
sentences.zh: 虽然对巴尔来说，得出结论、做出穆勒不愿做出的决定感觉很具有政治色彩，但我不得不认为，在巴尔看来，由国会来扮演这个角色会显得更具政治色彩。

sentences.en: to be the one to perform that role.
sentences.zh: 国会来扮演这个角色。

sentences.en: And so he was upset to have to make this call.
sentences.zh: 所以他虽然对不得不做出这个决定感到不满，

sentences.en: But it sounds like felt that he had to.
sentences.zh: 但听起来他觉得他不得不这么做。

sentences.en: I don't know if he's upset as much as he looks at this situation and says, this is not the way it's supposed to be working.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否有多不满，他只是看着这种情况并说：“这不是它应该运作的方式。”

sentences.en: Someone needs to make a decision on whether the president broke the law.
sentences.zh: 总得有人对总统是否违法做出决定。

sentences.en: I'll step in and do that.
sentences.zh: 我来介入并完成这件事。

sentences.en: And I think I can do that based on the facts.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我可以根据事实做到这一点。

sentences.en: And Congress can still play a role.
sentences.zh: 国会仍然可以发挥作用。

sentences.en: I'm redacting the report.
sentences.zh: 我正在对报告进行修订。

sentences.en: I'll give it to you with sensitive information blacked out.
sentences.zh: 我会把它交给你，敏感信息已被涂黑。

sentences.en: And then you can make your own judgment.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以做出你自己的判断。

sentences.en: But the public has an intense interest in this.
sentences.zh: 但公众对此有着极大的兴趣。

sentences.en: And I've got to say something.
sentences.zh: 我必须说点什么。

sentences.en: And I decide whether Axe broke the law or not.
sentences.zh: 我来决定Axe是否违法。

sentences.en: And I don't think this one did.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这个人做了。

sentences.en: Do we know if Mueller's team expected Barr to make this call on obstruction of justice after they declined to do so?
sentences.zh: 我们是否知道穆勒的团队是否期望巴尔在他们拒绝这样做之后，对妨碍司法公正做出这个决定？

sentences.en: We don't know precisely what the Mueller team expected on this obstruction question.
sentences.zh: 我们并不确切知道穆勒团队在这个妨碍司法公正的问题上有何期望。

sentences.en: It seems that they were not clear in communicating to the Justice Department what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们在向司法部传达他们想要什么时并不明确。

sentences.en: It may not have mattered anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这可能并不重要。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that after Barr came out with this four-page summary, which essentially exonerated the president on collusion and said he did not break the law
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，在巴尔发表了这四页摘要之后——该摘要基本上免除了总统在通俄方面的嫌疑，并表示他在

sentences.en: on obstruction, some members of Mr. Mueller's team felt that he had inadequately and only partially represented the work of their 22-month investigation.
sentences.zh: 妨碍司法公正方面没有违法——穆勒先生团队的一些成员认为，他未能充分且仅部分地展现他们为期 22 个月调查的工作。

sentences.en: So this is the other side of your reporting, that not only was the Barr side disappointed with the Mueller side.
sentences.zh: 所以这是你报道的另一个方面，不仅巴尔这一方对穆勒这一方感到失望，

sentences.en: The Mueller side was disappointed with the Barr side.
sentences.zh: 穆勒这一方也对巴尔这一方感到失望。

sentences.en: What we have learned is that since Barr made his public statement about a week ago, members of the Mueller team have told associates that they feel essentially that his work,
sentences.zh: 我们了解到的是，自从巴尔大约一周前发表公开声明以来，穆勒团队的成员告诉同僚，他们基本上觉得他的工作

sentences.en: if it wasn't misrepresentative of theirs, didn't give the full picture, which they believe is more damaging to the president than the attorney general's letter lets on.
sentences.zh: 即使没有歪曲他们的工作，也没有给出全貌，而他们认为全貌比司法部长的信件所透露的对总统更具破坏性。

sentences.en: Now, we are not saying that every member of the Mueller team is frustrated by this.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们并不是说穆勒团队的每个成员都对此感到沮丧。

sentences.en: We don't know what Bob Mueller himself thinks.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道罗伯特·穆勒本人是怎么想的。

sentences.en: He remains one of the black boxes at the center of this investigation.
sentences.zh: 他仍然是这场调查核心处的黑箱之一。

sentences.en: But there are members of the team who were involved in the decision-making around these issues that we've been talking about,
sentences.zh: 但团队中有参与我们一直在讨论的这些问题决策的成员，

sentences.en: who have watched and been disappointed and angry about how it's being characterized.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在关注并对对其工作的定性感到失望和愤怒。

sentences.en: And what is the focus of their disappointment, to the degree you understand it?
sentences.zh: 据你所了解的程度，他们失望的焦点是什么？

sentences.en: So when they read Bill Barr's concise four-page letter, they were frustrated that he had not drawn more from their own work.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们阅读威廉·巴尔那份简短的四页信件时，他们感到沮丧的是，他没有从他们自己的工作中吸取更多内容。

sentences.en: And in fact, what we discovered in reporting this piece out is that they had prepared summaries of their own work that were part of the report that they handed over to
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在深入报道这篇稿件时发现，他们准备了自己工作的摘要，作为他们几周前提交给

sentences.en: the Justice Department a couple of weeks ago and felt that some of that material could have easily been drawn into what Mr. Barr handed over.
sentences.zh: 司法部的报告的一部分，并且觉得其中一些材料完全可以被吸收到巴尔先生交出的报告中。

sentences.en: So not that he shouldn't have made a decision about whether the president obstructed justice or not in a criminal sense, but that concurrent with that,
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说他不应该在犯罪意义上对总统是否妨碍司法公正做出决定，而是与此同时，

sentences.en: he should have put out more of their evidence or analysis to kind of fill out the public picture.
sentences.zh: 他本应该公布更多他们的证据或分析，以充实公众的看法。

sentences.en: The Justice Department says those summaries had sensitive information in them, classified information, grand jury, secretive grand jury information that couldn't become public and
sentences.zh: 司法部表示，这些摘要中包含敏感信息、机密信息、大陪审团信息、不能公开的秘密大陪审团信息，

sentences.en: ultimately didn't use any of it.
sentences.zh: 最终根本没有使用其中的任何内容。

sentences.en: So what Mueller's folks are essentially saying is, hey, we wrote these summaries.
sentences.zh: 所以穆勒的人基本上是在说：“嘿，我们写了这些摘要。”

sentences.en: If you were going to go out and say something about this investigation and you were going to do something as extreme or as
sentences.zh: “如果你打算对这项调查说些什么，并且你打算做出像还总统清白这样极端或

sentences.en: declarative as clearing the president, why is it that you didn't include some of the things that we found?
sentences.zh: 定论性的举动，为什么你没有把我们发现的一些事情包含进去呢？”

sentences.en: And specifically, why didn't you include some stuff that we found that was pretty damning?
sentences.zh: “特别是，为什么不把我们发现的一些相当确凿的证据包含进去？”

sentences.en: You're making it seem like the president didn't do anything wrong.
sentences.zh: “你把事情搞得好像总统没做错任何事一样。”

sentences.en: Donald Trump has come out in the days after Barr's declaration and said the Mueller report was beautiful and it completely exonerates him.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在巴尔发表声明后的几天里公开表示，穆勒报告非常棒，完全还了他清白。

sentences.en: If you're an investigator who spent the last two years looking at Donald Trump and you think there's
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名调查员，过去两年都在调查唐纳德·特朗普，并且你认为

sentences.en: a lot of questionable behavior there, that is something that is going to irritate you mightily.
sentences.zh: 其中存在大量可疑行为，这绝对是一件让人极其恼火的事。

sentences.en: I mean, do either of you think that the Mueller people have a legitimate point here or is this a classic case of pride of authorship?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们两个是否觉得穆勒团队在这里抓到了合理的重点，还是这纯粹是出于文人相轻的经典案例？

sentences.en: They wanted to see their work in the public summary.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想把自己的工作成果展现在公开摘要里。

sentences.en: I don't think that we fully know.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们并不是完全了解。

sentences.en: What seems clear in our reporting is that there was no specific communication or agreement by the Mueller team to the Barr team.
sentences.zh: 从我们的报道中看来，明确的是穆勒团队和巴尔团队之间并没有过具体的沟通或协议。

sentences.en: You should use these things or we want these things to be out.
sentences.zh: 比如你们应该用这些东西，或者我们希望这些东西公之于众。

sentences.en: They seem to have had an intention and they certainly now have a regret about it.
sentences.zh: 他们当时似乎确实有过某种意图，而且他们现在对此肯定也感到后悔。

sentences.en: But we don't know what interaction there was in the actual decision making process that happened that weekend two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道在两周前的那个周末所发生的实际决策过程中，到底有过怎样的互动。

sentences.en: Well, so why do we think that Barr chose not to include more of what was in these summaries, especially the negative material, in his four-page summary?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们觉得巴尔在四页的摘要中，选择不纳入更多这些摘要里的内容，尤其是那些负面材料呢？

sentences.en: I think there's one big broad reason and another contemporary reason.
sentences.zh: 我认为这背后有一个宏观的大背景原因，以及另一个与当下有关的原因。

sentences.en: The broad reason being that Barr and many Justice Department officials and for many years prosecutors believe that if they
sentences.zh: 宏观上的原因在于，巴尔以及许多司法部官员，还有多年的检察官们都认为，如果他们

sentences.en: decide not to charge someone, the fruits of the investigation should not be just thrown out there for the public or for the enemies of the person who were investigated.
sentences.zh: 决定不对某人提起指控，那么调查的成果就不应该仅仅倾倒给公众，或者给那些被调查者的政敌。

sentences.en: Dirty laundry should not be aired if the subject of those dirty laundry are not charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 如果被调查对象没有被指控犯罪，那些见不得光的内幕就不应该被公之于众。

sentences.en: If you cannot meet this incredibly high bar of bringing a federal prosecution, that doesn't mean you then get to just take the trash
sentences.zh: 如果你无法达到提起联邦诉讼那条极其苛刻的高标准，这并不意味着你就可以顺便把这些垃圾

sentences.en: and just sort of throw it out in the street and let the public rummage through it.
sentences.zh: 直接倒在大街上，让公众去里面翻找。

sentences.en: And Mike, by the contemporary example you referred to, I'm assuming you're talking about James Comey.
sentences.zh: 迈克，关于你刚才提到的那个当下的例子，我猜你指的是詹姆士·科米。

sentences.en: I'm talking about the July 2016 press conference that James Comey held.
sentences.zh: 我指的是詹姆士·科米在2016年7月举行的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: It's right in the heat of the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 那正值总统大选的白热化阶段。

sentences.en: He stands up and says, we the FBI have done this investigation into Hillary Clinton's use of a private email account.
sentences.zh: 他站出来说，我们联邦调查局对希拉里·克林顿使用私人电子邮箱账户一事进行了调查。

sentences.en: We don't think there's a case to be made here, but we found some very questionable behavior in how she handled sensitive national security secrets.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这构不上起诉案件，但我们发现在她处理敏感国家安全机密的方式上，存在一些非常可疑的行为。

sentences.en: The press conference was seen as very damaging to Clinton, even though a case was never made.
sentences.zh: 这场新闻发布会被认为对克林顿极具杀伤力，尽管最终并未对其提起诉讼。

sentences.en: And so you're saying that Barr's view would be, I'm not going to be the one to replicate that by drawing from
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，巴尔的观点会是：我绝不会去效仿那种做法，通过摘录

sentences.en: these Mueller team summaries and putting those out into the public sphere.
sentences.zh: 这些穆勒团队的摘要并把它们公之于众。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We don't use criminal investigations to go out and find damaging things that may not be crimes that we then simply release to the public to be used against someone.
sentences.zh: 我们不会利用刑事调查去搜寻那些可能不构成犯罪但却具有破坏性的东西，然后直接把它们公之于众，用来对付某人。

sentences.en: The problem is this was never a normal or average criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这从来都不是一场正常或普通的刑事调查。

sentences.en: It has broad national security implications.
sentences.zh: 它具有广泛的国家安全影响。

sentences.en: It has implications for almost every decision that's made at the highest levels of the government.
sentences.zh: 它对政府最高层所做出的几乎每一项决策都有影响。

sentences.en: This is more about a pathway of how you deal with the president's conduct.
sentences.zh: 这更关乎一条如何处理总统行为的途径。

sentences.en: And what it appears from the Mueller side is that they're saying, look, this is the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而从穆勒方面来看，他们的态度似乎是：听着，这是美利坚合众国的总统。

sentences.en: There's some conduct here that we think the public in Congress should see.
sentences.zh: 这里有些行为，我们认为公众和国会有必要看到。

sentences.en: And OK, Justice Department, it may not be criminal, but this is the president.
sentences.zh: 好吧，司法部，这可能不构成犯罪，但这是总统。

sentences.en: And this needs to be examined more thoroughly by the political process and by Congress.
sentences.zh: 这需要通过政治程序和国会来进行更彻底的审查。

sentences.en: It's about a pathway of dealing with the president.
sentences.zh: 这关乎处理总统行为的途径问题。

sentences.en: And Bill Barr doesn't seem to disagree with that fundamentally.
sentences.zh: 而比尔·巴尔似乎从根本上并不反对这一点。

sentences.en: He said throughout that he wants to make as much of this report public as possible, but he doesn't think that that absolves him of the
sentences.zh: 他一直表示，他希望尽可能多地将这份报告公之于众，但他认为这并不意味着他可以免除

sentences.en: Justice Department's role of saying whether or not the president or his campaign broke the law.
sentences.zh: 司法部的职责，即判定总统或其竞选团队究竟有没有触犯法律。

sentences.en: And so he's grappling with the Justice Department's aversion to talk about individuals that it's not saying broke the law.
sentences.zh: 因此，他一方面在竭力克服司法部不愿谈论那些未被指控违法之人的习惯，

sentences.en: But yet he knows that the public and the Congress want and probably are owed more information about what did happen.
sentences.zh: 另一方面又深知公众和国会想要、并且可能也理应获得更多关于到底发生了什么的信息。

sentences.en: And so kind of operating somewhere in the middle of those two things.
sentences.zh: 所以他某种程度上是在这两者之间的中间地带运作。

sentences.en: The difference here is that if I was under investigation and the Justice Department determined that I didn't
sentences.zh: 这里的区别在于，如果我正在接受调查，而司法部认定我没有

sentences.en: break the law, then there's no other process that really needs to be dealt with me.
sentences.zh: 触犯法律，那么就没有其他什么程序真正需要针对我展开了。

sentences.en: Maybe my company needs to decide whether I get fired or not for that conduct.
sentences.zh: 也许我的公司需要决定是否要因这种行为而将我解雇。

sentences.en: In this instance, there's another issue with the president.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，针对总统还有另一个问题。

sentences.en: OK, the president didn't break the law.
sentences.zh: 好吧，总统没有触犯法律。

sentences.en: But maybe the president did things with his power that the public should know about, Congress should know about and need to be more closely examined,
sentences.zh: 但也许总统利用他的权力做了一些公众应该知道、国会应该知道、并且需要受到更密切审查的事情，

sentences.en: because maybe it's not just about breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 因为这可能不仅仅关乎是否违法。

sentences.en: It's about how he conducted himself as president.
sentences.zh: 这关乎他作为总统的行事作风。

sentences.en: And does Congress need to deal with that?
sentences.zh: 国会是否需要处理这个问题？

sentences.en: And what we are starting to see from Mueller's side is this frustration that, hey, we think there's some bad stuff that happened here.
sentences.zh: 而我们开始从穆勒方面看到的是这样一种沮丧感：嘿，我们认为这里发生了一些很不好的事情。

sentences.en: But by Barr coming out and not disclosing that, but saying the president didn't break the law, he is casting the die on how the public will later look at the president's conduct.
sentences.zh: 但巴尔出来之后没有披露这些，反而说总统没有违法，这就在很大程度上左右了公众日后看待总统行为的方式。

sentences.en: They will say that for several weeks after we finished our report, the only thing that was out there was Bill Barr saying the president didn't break the law
sentences.zh: 他们会说，在我们完成报告后的好几个星期里，外界唯一能听到的声音就是比尔·巴尔说总统没有违法，

sentences.en: and the president turned around and saying, I was fully exonerated.
sentences.zh: 而总统转头也说自己被完全洗白了。

sentences.en: And they're saying, hey, America, we think more of this process needs to play out.
sentences.zh: 他们想说的是：嘿，美国民众，我们认为这个调查程序还有更多内容需要展开。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this all comes down to the vexing question of how do we investigate a sitting president?
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都归结到一个棘手的问题：我们该如何调查一位在任总统？

sentences.en: And how is that done in a way that the public has the utmost confidence in that?
sentences.zh: 又该如何以一种让公众拥有最高信任度的方式来进行？

sentences.en: And in that is this tension between how much independence the investigator should have.
sentences.zh: 而在其中，夹杂着调查人员究竟应该拥有多少独立性的这种张力。

sentences.en: In Nixon, that pendulum swung too far in the president's direction.
sentences.zh: 在尼克松时期，这个天平向总统的方向倾斜得太过了。

sentences.en: In the star investigation of Clinton, it went the other way.
sentences.zh: 而在针对克林顿的斯塔尔调查中，情况走向了另一个极端。

sentences.en: The investigator had too much power.
sentences.zh: 调查人员拥有了过大的权力。

sentences.en: And here between Mueller and Barr's teams, they are fighting that same fight and have different understandings of how this should all be dealt with.
sentences.zh: 而现在，在穆勒和巴尔的团队之间，他们正在进行着同样的博弈，对于这一切应该如何处理有着不同的理解。

sentences.en: And it's the same issue that we've been looking at for 50 years, just the latest episode of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们50年来一直在关注的同一个问题，只不过是它的最新一集罢了。

sentences.en: So inside of one presidential investigation, these two teams are embodying all the tensions that have basically been present since Watergate.
sentences.zh: 因此，在单一的一场总统调查内部，这两个团队体现了自水门事件以来基本上就一直存在的所有张力。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's how much you can tell the public and how is apparent misconduct by the president dealt with.
sentences.zh: 这关乎你能向公众透露多少，以及如何处理总统明显的失职行为。

sentences.en: And there's no clear pathway on that.
sentences.zh: 而对此并没有一条清晰的途径。

sentences.en: So whatever
sentences.zh: 所以无论

sentences.en: Barr does will be viewed by one side as political and laying on the brakes for the president.
sentences.zh: 巴尔做什么，在一方看来都会带有政治色彩，是在为总统踩刹车。

sentences.en: Whatever
sentences.zh: 无论

sentences.en: Mueller does will be viewed by the president's enemies as trying to get him.
sentences.zh: 穆勒做什么，在总统的政敌看来都会被视为是在刻意整他。

sentences.en: And the confidence in that process then erodes.
sentences.zh: 而对这一程序的信任度也随之被侵蚀。

sentences.en: And it's messy and it's hard to figure out what are the real facts here?
sentences.zh: 这很混乱，也很难弄清楚这里的真实事实究竟是什么？

sentences.en: What really happened?
sentences.zh: 真正发生的到底是什么？

sentences.en: But at this point, we're just talking about the summary that Bill Barr sent to
sentences.zh: 但在目前这个阶段，我们讨论的仅仅是比尔·巴尔发送给

sentences.en: Congress.
sentences.zh: 国会的摘要。

sentences.en: We're still waiting on the full report.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在等待完整的报告。

sentences.en: So won't this tension that you are describing eventually be more or less resolved when we learn how much information we'll ultimately have access to?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你最终了解我们究竟能获得多少信息的权限时，你所描述的这种张力难道最终不会或多或少地得到解决吗？

sentences.en: It may be.
sentences.zh: 也许会的。

sentences.en: And we may see a very different set of facts at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 而且到头来我们可能会看到一套非常不同的事实。

sentences.en: But I think the question here is about who sets the narrative for the intervening period of time.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里的问题在于，究竟是谁在为中间这段时间定调。

sentences.en: It may end up being a month before we see a fuller version of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 我们可能还得等上一个月，才能看到更完整的穆勒报告版本。

sentences.en: And for that time, Bill Barr's conclusion that the president didn't break the law is going to be the kind of dominant narrative.
sentences.zh: 而在那段时间里，比尔·巴尔关于总统没有违法的结论将成为那种占主导地位的叙事。

sentences.en: And I think that what we're hearing from members of the Mueller team is a concern that by the time their fuller work does come out, the narrative is baked.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们从穆勒团队成员那里听到的是一种担忧：当他们更完整的工作成果终于公布时，舆论风向已经盖棺定论了。

sentences.en: So much so that even if it shows, for instance, that the president didn't break the law,
sentences.zh: 以至于哪怕报告显示，举例来说，总统虽然没有违法，

sentences.en: but abused his office or conducted acts that Congress will deem, you know, inappropriate for his office, that there's not room to have a full debate around that.
sentences.zh: 但却滥用了职权，或者实施了国会认为不适合其总统身份的行为，也没有空间来围绕这些展开充分的辩论了。

sentences.en: That the conclusions about the work that they did for 22 months will have been prejudged at that point and that it won't quite matter what the report says
sentences.zh: 到那个时候，关于他们历时22个月所做工作的结论已经被提前判定了，届时报告具体写了什么其实已经无足轻重了

sentences.en: for the president's political fate.
sentences.zh: ，无法改变总统的政治命运。

sentences.en: Nick, Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 尼克，迈克，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，伙计们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们来做客。

sentences.en: The committee has a job to do.
sentences.zh: 委员会有一项工作要做。

sentences.en: The Constitution charges Congress withholding the president accountable for alleged official misconduct.
sentences.zh: 宪法赋予国会追究总统涉嫌官方失职责任的权力。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the House Judiciary Committee voted to authorize the use of subpoenas to obtain a full copy of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 周三，众议院司法委员会投票授权使用传票，以获取穆勒报告的完整副本。

sentences.en: That job requires us to evaluate the evidence for ourselves, not the attorney general's summary,
sentences.zh: 这项工作要求我们自行评估证据，而不是依赖司法部长的摘要，

sentences.en: not a substantially redacted synopsis, but the full report and the underlying evidence.
sentences.zh: 也不是依赖经过大量删节的梗概，而是要看完整的报告和基础证据。

sentences.en: The committee's chairman, Democratic Representative Jerry Nadler of New York, said he would not immediately issue a subpoena, but his power to do so will intensify pressure
sentences.zh: 委员会主席、来自纽约州的民主党众议员杰里·纳德勒表示，他不会立即发出传票，但这方面的权力将加大对

sentences.en: on the attorney general, William Barr, to quickly release an unredacted copy of the report.
sentences.zh: 司法部长威廉·巴尔的压力，迫使其尽快发布一份未经删节的报告副本。

sentences.en: I will give him time to change his mind, but if we cannot reach an accommodation, then we will have no choice but to issue subpoenas for these materials.
sentences.zh: 我会给他时间改变主意，但如果我们无法达成一致，那我们将别无选择，只能对这些材料发出传票。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，去看看《时报》的订阅者每天都能看到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请在今天下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A Times analysis of deadly terror attacks involving white extremists has found that at least a third of them were inspired by fellow white men who carried out similar attacks
sentences.zh: 《时报》对涉及白人极端分子的致命恐怖袭击进行的一项分析发现，其中至少有三分之一是由同案白人男性煽动或启发进行的，这些人实施了类似的袭击，

sentences.en: and had either professed admiration for them or interest in their tactics.
sentences.zh: 并且要么公开表示对他们（前人）的钦佩，要么对他们的战术感兴趣。

sentences.en: In one case, a school shooter in New Mexico corresponded with a gunman who attacked a mall in Munich.
sentences.zh: 在一个案例中，新墨西哥州的一名校园枪手曾与一名袭击慕尼黑购物中心的枪手进行过通信。

sentences.en: Altogether, the two men killed 11 people.
sentences.zh: 这两个人总共杀害了11人。

sentences.en: The connections between the killers cross continents and highlight how the internet and social media have spread white extremism.
sentences.zh: 凶手之间的联系跨越了各大洲，凸显了互联网和社交媒体是如何传播白人极端主义的。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: I've always tried to be, in my career, I've always tried to make a human connection.
sentences.zh: 我在职业生涯中一直努力去做到，我一直努力建立人与人之间的情感连接。

sentences.en: That's my responsibility, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我的责任。

sentences.en: I shake hands, I hug people, I grab men and women by the shoulders and say, you can do this.
sentences.zh: 我与人握手，拥抱他人，抓着男男女女的肩膀对他们说，你能做到这一点。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, former Vice President Joe Biden responded to a series of complaints from women that his close physical contact had made them uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 周三，前副总统乔·拜登回应了一系列来自女性的抱怨，称他过分亲密的身体接触让她们感到不适。

sentences.en: Social norms have begun to change, they've shifted, and the boundaries of protecting personal space have been reset.
sentences.zh: 社会规范已经开始改变，它们发生了转变，保护个人空间的界限也被重新设定了。

sentences.en: And I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: I hear what they're saying.
sentences.zh: 我听到了她们的说法。

sentences.en: I understand it.
sentences.zh: 我理解。

sentences.en: In a video message sent as Biden prepares for a possible presidential run, he defended his behavior, but said he is able to change.
sentences.zh: 在拜登为可能参加总统竞选做准备之际发布的一段视频信息中，他为自己的行为进行了辩解，但也表示自己能够做出改变。

sentences.en: But I always believe, governing, quite frankly, life for that matter, is about connecting.
sentences.zh: 但我始终认为，坦白讲，治理国家，乃至生活本身，关键都在于建立连接。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为筹办节日聚会做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取小贴士，让你的客人们宾至如归。

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》App上或通过您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
